row:
The North Fork’s premier equestrian facility, North Fork Equestrian is sited on over 21 acres of bucolic farmland, conveniently located in Riverhead, NY. This picturesque, world-class, equestrian complex is built to satisfy both the casual rider and Grand Prix athlete.

North Fork Equestrian features a 78'x185' indoor riding arena welcoming rider and horse with state of the art, travel right, dust free footing, surrounding mirrors, an insulated ceiling, and a stereo system throughout, 24 individual 12'x12' stalls, 2 indoor wash stalls with warm/cold water year-round, 2 outdoor wash stalls, 2 large boarder tack rooms, 25 grass turnout paddocks, and a 220'x160' outdoor ring with footing consisting of felt fibers and sand with ideal drainage and layout, allowing all year riding with the ultimate footing to satisfy any equestrian with a beautiful backdrop of landscaped trees.
